assessments.reasoning: The two ranges cover SPDX's complete 25,137-byte detail record at the claimed data commit. It gives OLDAP-1.2, isDeprecatedLicenseId=false, the 1 September 1998 heading and the claimed gitweb reference in both crossRef and seeAlso.
The repository API records unsigned annotated tag v3.29.0 targeting the commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 used for OLDAP-1.2.json. The tag establishes the release pin.

The contextual capture at https://git.openldap.org/openldap/openldap/-/raw/42b0383c50c299977b5893ee695cf4e486fb0dc7/LICENSE matches the claim's publisher digest and identifies the Foundation and 1.2 inline. Its locator differs from SPDX's HTTP gitweb URL.

challenge.method: Tested whether the common 1.2 version label resolves all four reported issuances and whether the generated display name or match flag establishes an exact text match.
challenge.results: The specific hb value resolves which source SPDX cites. The generated name spells “Open LDAP,” the text says “OpenLDAP,” and crossRef.match is the string “false.” The citation and captured locator support the claim even though equivalence across issuances remains provisional.

limitations: SPDX's account of the four issuances is attributed to SPDX. The other representations and the historical endpoint's bytes remain unverified. Byte or legal equivalence, file applicability, permissions and publication remain outside the finding.
reasoning: The SPDX 3.29.0 OLDAP-1.2 record cites HTTP gitweb with f=LICENSE and hb=42b0383c50c299977b5893ee695cf4e486fb0dc7. OpenLDAP's captured raw path carries that commit, and the inline title, date and version agree with SPDX licenseText.
